tools.name: search_bottles
tools.description: Search the Red Good Wine index of wine, beer, spirits and zero-proof bottles from independent US shops by name, producer, grape, region or style, optionally by category, style and a maximum price.

tools.name: bottle_offers
tools.description: Every shop that lists one bottle, cheapest in stock first, with price, stock, the US states the shop ships alcohol to (when known) and a link. Pass the bottle's Red Good Wine slug or page URL (from search_bottles or recommend_bottles). Paid tool: first 3 calls/day free, then pay with prepaid credits

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recommend_bottles, bottle_offers, best_price, price_index · Private data: recommend_bottles, bottle_offers, best_price, price_index · Public sink: recommend_bottles, bottle_offers, best_price, price_index.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recommend_bottles, bottle_offers, best_price, price_index · Private data: recommend_bottles, bottle_offers, best_price, price_index · Public sink: recommend_bottles, bottle_offers, best_price, price_index

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "recommend_bottles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
